content.short: Kevlar is a local RPC proxy for proof of stake or post-merge Ethereum wallets.
content.description: Kevlar provides a client-side RPC layer that sits between an RPC-based wallet and every transaction request, introducing an independent verification step before requests reach the wallet. This layer reduces the amount of trust required in external systems by ensuring wallet interactions pass through verifiable checks. When Kevlar is installed and attached to a wallet, each transaction path undergoes block header verification, helping to identify and block potentially malicious transactions before they are submitted to the network.
content.meta: Kevlar is a local RPC proxy adding a verification layer for wallets and transactions. Discover Kevlar and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
